46377.subject: Physics
46377.question_text: Why do soldiers march disorderly while crossing a bridge?
46377.explanation: Soldiers march disorderly while crossing a bridge to prevent resonance because when soldiers march in orderly manner across a bridge, they generate a rhythmic oscillation of wave on the bridge and at a certain point, would start oscillation to the same rhythm as that of the marching steps. This oscillation would reach a maximum peak when the bridge can no longer sustain its own strength and hence collapses. So for this reasons, soldier are ordered to march disorderly while crossing a bridge.

options.text: To prevent resonance on the bridge
To set the bridge into resonance
To make the b ridge collapse
To spread their weight evenly on the bridge

46378.question_text: Calculate the upthrust on an object of volume 50cm3 which is immersed in liquid of density \(10^{3}\) kgm-3 [g = 10ms-2]

density = \(\frac{\text{mass}}{\text{volume}}\)

Mass of liquid displaced = Density of Liquid × Volume;

= \(10^{3} \times 50 \times 10^{−6}m^{3}\)

= 0.05kg

(Note that the volume of \(50cm^{3}\) was converted to \(m^{3}\) by multiplying by \(10^{6}\)) i.e \(50cm^{3} = 50 \times 10^{−6}m^{3}\)

Since mass displaced = 0.05kg

Upthrust = mg = 0.05 × 10

= 0.5N

25 = mv

∴ Final momentum = 25kgms\(^{-1}\)

46441.subject: Physics
46441.question_text: Calculate the angle of minimum deviation of a 60º prism of a refractive index 1.5[ \(sin^{-1}\) (0.75) = 49º]
46441.explanation:
For a refractive index () = \(\frac{\sin\frac{1}{2} (A + D)}{\sin\frac{1}{2}A}\)

D = angle of minimum deviation

A = refractive angle of the prism

1.5 = \(\frac{\sin\frac{1}{2} (60 + D)}{\sin\frac{1}{2} \times 60}\)

1.5 = \(\frac{\sin\frac{1}{2} (60 + D)}{\sin 30}\)

Sin \(\frac{1}{2}\) (60 + D) = 1.5 * Sin 30

Sin \(\frac{1}{2}\) (60 + D) = 0.75

\(\frac{1}{2}\) (60 + D) = Sin-1 (0.75)

but Sin-1 (0.75) = 49o

\(\frac{1}{2}\) (60 + D) = 49

60 + D = 2 * 49 = 98o

D = 98o - 60o

D = 38o

= 57.12
